units.en: Heaven's blessing rests upon you; the imperial regalia comes unbidden. Truly receive Heaven's Mandate and forever pacify the myriad people — hold it in reverence!"
units.literal: Heaven's blessing is upon your person, the divine vessel comes of itself; truly gather Heaven's Mandate, forever pacify the myriad people — reverence it!"

units.zh: 是日，帝自臯門入大內，禦崇元殿，即皇帝位。
units.en: That day the Emperor entered the Inner Palace through Gaomen Gate, ascended Chongyuan Hall, and took the throne.
units.literal: That day the Emperor entered the Inner Palace through Gaomen Gate, took the throne in Chongyuan Hall, and assumed the imperial position.

units.zh: 制曰：
units.en: An edict read:
units.literal: An edict stated:

units.zh: 自古受命之君，興邦建統，莫不上符天意，下順人心。
units.en: "Since antiquity no sovereign who received the Mandate and founded a dynasty has failed to align with Heaven above and the people's hearts below."
units.literal: "From antiquity, sovereigns who received the Mandate, who raised states and established succession, have none failed to match Heaven's intent above and accord with the people's hearts below."

units.zh: 是以夏德既衰，爰啟有商之祚；
units.en: "When Xia's virtue waned, Shang's fortune opened;"
units.literal: "Thus when Xia's virtue had waned, then the fortune of Shang was opened;"

units.zh: 炎風不競，肇開皇魏之基。
units.en: "when Han's vigor faltered, Wei laid its foundation."
units.literal: "when the Blazing Wind was no longer competitive, the foundation of Imperial Wei was first opened."

units.zh: 朕早事前朝，久居重位。
units.en: "I long served the previous dynasty and long held high office."
units.literal: "I long served the previous dynasty and long held heavy office."

units.zh: 受遺輔政，敢忘伊、霍之忠；
units.en: "Entrusted at deathbed to assist in government, I never forgot the loyalty of Yi Yin and Huo Guang;"
units.literal: "Receiving the deathbed charge to assist in government, how could I forget the loyalty of Yi Yin and Huo Guang;"

units.zh: 仗鉞臨戎，復委韓、彭之任。
units.en: "bearing the commander's axe on campaign, again entrusted with tasks worthy of Han Xin and Peng Yue."
units.literal: "bearing the battle-axe and facing warfare, again entrusted with the charge of Han Xin and Peng Yue."

units.zh: 匪躬盡瘁，焦思勞心，討叛渙於河、潼，張聲援於岐、雍，竟平大憝，粗立微勞。
units.en: "I spared neither body nor mind, burning with worry and toil. I punished rebels at the He and Tong region, extended support through Qi and Yong, and at last put down the great enemy — a small merit, but real."
units.literal: "Not sparing my person I exhausted my strength, burned with thought and toiled in heart; I punished scattered rebels at the He and Tong region, extended sounding support at Qi and Yong, and in the end pacified the great enemy and roughly established slight merit."

units.zh: 才旋騑於關西，尋統兵於河朔，訓齊師旅，固護邊陲，只將身許國家，不以賊遺君父。
units.en: "Hardly had I turned from the western passes when I took command in Heshuo, drilled the army, and held the frontier — offering my person to the state and leaving no enemy for my sovereign to face."
units.literal: "Just as I turned my horses in the Guanxi region, soon I took command of troops in Heshuo, trained and aligned the army hosts, solidly protected the frontier marches, and pledged my person to the state alone, not leaving the enemy to my sovereign and father."

units.zh: 外憂少息，內患俄生，群小連謀，大臣遇害，棟梁既壞，社稷將傾。
units.en: "External threats had barely eased when internal calamity erupted. Petty men conspired; great ministers were slain. The pillars were broken; the altars of state near collapse."
units.literal: "External worries had just eased when internal calamity suddenly arose; petty men conspired in league, great ministers met harm, the pillars and beams were already ruined, and the altars of state were about to topple."

units.zh: 朕方在藩維，以遭讒構。
units.en: "I was at my frontier post when slander framed me."
units.literal: "I was then at my frontier post and suffered slander and framing."

units.zh: 逃一生於萬死，徑赴闕庭；
units.en: "Escaping death by a hair, I marched straight to the capital;"
units.literal: "Escaping one life from ten thousand deaths, I went straight to the palace court;"

units.zh: 梟四罪於九衢，幸安區宇。
units.en: "executed the four criminals at the public crossroads and, by good fortune, restored peace to the realm."
units.literal: "displayed four criminals at the nine crossroads, and by fortune secured peace for the realm."

units.zh: 將延漢祚，擇立劉宗，征命已行，軍情忽變。
units.en: "Intending to preserve Han's line, I chose an heir of the Liu house. The summons had gone out when the army's mood suddenly turned."
units.literal: "Intending to extend Han's fortune, I chose and established the Liu house; the summons had already been issued when the army's mood suddenly changed."

units.zh: 朕以眾庶所迫，逃避無由，扶擁至京，尊戴為主。
units.en: "Compelled by the multitude with no way to refuse, I was escorted to the capital and acclaimed as sovereign."
units.literal: "Compelled by the multitude, with no way to decline, I was supported and escorted to the capital and honored and upheld as lord."

units.zh: 重以中外勸進，方嶽推崇，黽勉雖順於群心，臨御實慚於涼德。
units.en: "Urged further by court and field and acclaimed by the regional lords, I comply though the multitude wills it — yet in taking the throne I am ashamed of my slight virtue."
units.literal: "Further urged on by court and countryside, praised by the regional peaks, though I exert myself in compliance with the multitude's hearts, in assuming rule I am truly ashamed of my meager virtue."

units.zh: 改元建號，祗率於舊章；
units.en: "In changing the era name and founding the dynasty, I reverently follow established precedent;"
units.literal: "Changing the era name and establishing the dynastic title, reverently follow the old statutes;"

units.zh: 革故鼎新，宜覃於霈澤。
units.en: "in replacing the old order and renewing the state, broad grace should pour forth in amnesty."
units.literal: "replacing the old and renewing the vessel, broad grace ought to extend in streaming beneficence."

units.zh: 朕本姬室之遠裔，虢叔之後昆，積慶累功，格天光表，盛德既延於百世，大命復集於眇躬，今建國宜以大周為號，可改漢乾祐四年為廣順元年。
units.en: "I am a distant scion of the Ji house, descended from Guo Shu. Blessings and merit accumulated until they reached Heaven; virtue long sustained now gathers the Mandate upon my humble person. The new state shall be called Great Zhou, and the fourth year of Han Qianyou shall become Guangshun 1."
units.literal: "I am originally a distant scion of the Ji house, a descendant of Guo Shu, accumulated blessings and accumulated merit reaching Heaven with luminous display; abundant virtue already extended through a hundred generations, and the great mandate again gathered upon my insignificant person — now in establishing the state the title Great Zhou is fitting; the fourth year of Qianyou of Han may be changed to the first year of Guangshun."

units.zh: 自正月五日昧爽已前，應天下罪人，常赦所不原者，咸赦除之。
units.en: "Effective before dawn on the fifth of the first month, all criminals throughout the realm whom ordinary amnesties would not cover are fully pardoned."
units.literal: "From before dawn on the fifth day of the first month onward, all criminals throughout the realm whom ordinary amnesties do not pardon — all alike are pardoned and released."

units.zh: 故樞密使楊邠、侍衛都指揮使史宏肇、三司使王章等，以勞定國，盡節致君，千載逢時，一旦同命，悲感行路，憤結重泉，雖尋雪於沈冤，宜更伸於渥澤，並可加等追贈，備禮歸葬，葬事官給，仍訪子孫敘用。
units.en: "Former Commissioner Yang Bin, Palace Guard Commander Shi Hongzhao, and Three Departments Commissioner Wang Zhang, among others, labored to settle the realm and gave their lives in loyal service. In a single morning they met a fate that moved all who passed on the road. Though their wrongs have been cleared, generous posthumous honors are due: promotion in rank, full burial rites at state expense, and their descendants sought out for appointment."
units.literal: "The former Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Yang Bin, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Shi Hongzhao, Commissioner of the Three Departments Wang Zhang, and others, through labor settled the state and exhausted loyalty in serving their lord; meeting the age once in a thousand years, in a single morning they shared the same fate; grief moved passersby on the road, indignation bound the deep springs; though their submerged wrongs were soon cleared, generous grace ought further to be extended — all may receive posthumous promotion by rank, full rites of return burial, burial expenses supplied by the state, and their descendants sought out for appointment."

units.zh: 其餘同遭枉害者，亦與追贈。
units.en: "Others who suffered wrongful harm shall likewise receive posthumous honors."
units.literal: "The others who likewise suffered wrongful harm shall also receive posthumous honors."

units.zh: 馬步諸軍將士等，戮力葉誠，輸忠效義，先則平持內難，後乃推戴朕躬，言念勛勞，所宜旌賞。
units.en: "The cavalry and infantry who pledged their loyalty — first quelling internal disorder, then urging my elevation — deserve commemoration and reward."
units.literal: "Cavalry and infantry officers and soldiers of all armies, exerting strength and pledging sincerity, rendering loyalty and displaying righteousness — first pacifying and holding firm against internal calamity, afterward urging my elevation — speaking of their meritorious labors, rewards and honors are fitting."

units.zh: 其原屬將士等，各與等第，超加恩命，仍賜功臣名號，已帶功臣者別與改賜。
units.en: "Original troops shall receive graded promotions and extraordinary honors, with titles of merit conferred anew — those already bearing such titles shall receive renewed grants."
units.literal: "The original troops and soldiers shall each receive graded ranks, extraordinary additional honors, and titles of meritorious ministers; those already bearing meritorious titles shall receive separate replacement grants."

units.zh: 應左降官，未量移者與量移，已量移者與復資，已復資者量加敘錄。
units.en: "Demoted officials not yet reassigned shall be reassigned; those reassigned shall be restored; those restored shall receive further promotion as appropriate."
units.literal: "As for demoted officials: those not yet reassigned shall be reassigned; those already reassigned shall be restored to original rank; those already restored shall receive measured additional promotion and recording."

units.zh: 亡官失爵之人，宜與齒用，配流徒役人，並許放還。
units.en: "Those who lost office and rank may be considered for appointment; exiles, convicts, and corvée laborers are all permitted to return."
units.literal: "Persons who lost office and forfeited rank ought to be ranked for employment; those sentenced to exile, penal servitude, or corvée labor are all permitted to return."

units.zh: 諸處有犯罪逃亡之人，及山林草寇等，一切不問，如赦到後一月不歸本業者，復罪如初。
units.en: "Criminal fugitives and mountain bandits everywhere shall go unquestioned; but if they fail to return to honest livelihood within one month of the amnesty, their crimes revert."
units.literal: "Fugitives who committed crimes in various places, and mountain-forest bandits and the like — all shall not be questioned; if after the amnesty reaches them they do not return to their original livelihood within one month, their crimes revert as before."

units.zh: 內外前任、見任文武官僚致仕官，各與加恩。
units.en: "Retired as well as serving civil and military officials shall receive additional favors."
units.literal: "Former and current civil and military officials who have retired from office — each shall receive additional grace."

units.zh: 應在朝文武臣僚、內諸司使、諸道行軍副使、藩方馬步都指揮使，如父母在，未有恩澤者即與恩澤，已有者更與恩澤；
units.en: "For civil and military officials at court, inner-bureau commissioners, circuit deputy commanders, and frontier cavalry and infantry commanders: if their parents are living and have not yet received enfeoffment honors, grant them now; if already honored, grant additional honors;"
units.literal: "As for civil and military officials at court, commissioners of the inner bureaus, deputy campaign commanders of the various circuits, and cavalry and infantry commanders-in-chief of frontier regions: if their parents are living and have not yet received enfeoffment grace, grant enfeoffment grace at once; if they already have it, grant additional enfeoffment grace;"

units.zh: 如亡沒，未曾追封贈者亦與封贈，已封贈者更與封贈。
units.en: "if deceased and not yet posthumously enfeoffed, grant enfeoffment; if already enfeoffed, grant additional honors."
units.literal: "if deceased and not yet posthumously enfeoffed, likewise grant enfeoffment; if already enfeoffed posthumously, grant additional enfeoffment."

units.zh: 應天下州縣，所欠乾祐元年、二年已前夏秋殘稅及沿征物色，並三年夏稅諸色殘欠，並與除放。
units.en: "All outstanding summer and autumn taxes and collected goods in transit from before Qianyou 1 and 2, and all residual summer taxes of Qianyou 3, are remitted throughout the realm."
units.literal: "Throughout the realm's prefectures and counties, outstanding residual summer and autumn taxes before the first and second years of Qianyou and collected goods in transit, as well as all residual summer tax items of the third year — all alike shall be remitted."

units.zh: 澶州已來，官路兩邊共二十里內，並乾祐三年殘稅欠稅，並與除放。
units.en: "From Chanzhou eastward, all residual and overdue taxes of Qianyou 3 within twenty li on both sides of the imperial highway are remitted."
units.literal: "From Chanzhou onward, within twenty li on both sides of the imperial highway, residual and overdue taxes of the third year of Qianyou — all alike shall be remitted."

units.zh: 應河北沿邊州縣，自去年九月後來，曾經契丹蹂踐處，其人戶應欠乾祐三年終已前積年殘欠諸色稅物，並與除放。
units.en: "In Hebei frontier prefectures and counties ravaged by the Khitan since the ninth month of last year, all accumulated tax arrears through the end of Qianyou 3 are remitted."
units.literal: "As for prefectures and counties along the Hebei frontier, in places trampled and ravaged by the Khitan since after the ninth month of last year, all residual tax goods accumulated through the end of the third year of Qianyou owed by their households — all alike shall be remitted."

units.zh: 應系三司主持錢谷敗闕場院官取乾祐元年終已前征納外，灼然無抵當者，委三司分析聞奏。
units.en: "Where Three Departments revenue officials show depot deficits for collections before the end of Qianyou 1 and clearly lack collateral, the Three Departments shall investigate and report."
units.literal: "As for revenue officials of the Three Departments who managed funds and grain and whose depot accounts show deficits, for collections beyond the end of the first year of Qianyou where there is clearly no collateral — charge the Three Departments to analyze and report to the throne."

units.zh: 天下倉場、庫務，宜令節度使專切鈐轄，掌納官吏一依省條指揮，不得別納鬥餘、秤耗，舊來所進羨余物色，今後一切停罷。
units.en: "Granaries and storehouses throughout the realm shall be placed under military governors' strict supervision. Receiving officials must follow provincial regulations and may not levy surplus measures or scale wastage. All former surplus tribute is abolished."
units.literal: "Granaries and storehouses throughout the realm ought to be placed under the dedicated supervision of military governors; receiving officials shall follow provincial regulations in all respects, and may not separately collect surplus measures or scale wastage; goods of surplus tribute formerly submitted — from now on all alike cease."

units.zh: 應乘輿服禦之物，不得過為華飾，宮闈器用，務從樸素，大官常膳，一切減損。
units.en: "Imperial garments and accoutrements must not be excessively ornate; palace utensils shall be plain; the Chief Steward's regular meals shall all be reduced."
units.literal: "Imperial carriage garments and accoutrements must not be excessively ornate; palace utensils and implements should strive for simplicity; the Chief Steward's regular meals — all alike shall be reduced."

units.zh: 諸道所有進奉，以助軍國之費，其珍巧纖華及奇禽異獸鷹犬之類，不得輒有獻貢，諸無用之物、不急之務，並宜停罷。
units.en: "Circuit tribute meant to support military and state expenses must not include delicate luxuries, exotic birds and beasts, hawks, or hounds. All useless goods and non-urgent undertakings are to cease."
units.literal: "Tribute submissions from all circuits to assist military and state expenses — delicate, clever, fine, and ornate items, as well as exotic birds, beasts, hawks, and hounds and the like — must not be casually offered in tribute; all useless goods and non-urgent affairs alike ought to cease."

units.zh: 帝王之道，德化為先，崇飾虛名，朕所不取，茍致治之未洽，雖多端以奚為！
units.en: "The way of kings puts moral transformation first. Empty show and hollow reputation I reject — if governance is not yet sound, what use are many expedients!"
units.literal: "The way of emperors and kings puts moral transformation first; honoring and adorning empty reputation is what I do not accept — if governance is not yet harmonious, what use are many expedients!"

units.zh: 今後諸道所有祥瑞，不得輒有奏獻。
units.en: "Henceforth auspicious omens from all circuits must not be casually reported and offered."
units.literal: "From now on, auspicious omens in all circuits must not be casually memorialized and offered."

units.zh: 古者用刑，本期止辟，今茲作法，義切禁非。
units.en: "In antiquity punishment was used to end crime; now in establishing law, the aim is firmly to forbid wrongdoing."
units.literal: "In antiquity punishment was used with the aim of ending crime; now in establishing law, the principle is firmly to forbid wrongdoing."

units.zh: 蓋承弊之時，非猛則奸兇難制；
units.en: "For in a time of inherited decline, unless severity is applied the crafty and violent are hard to control;"
units.literal: "For in a time of inherited decline, unless severity is applied the crafty and violent are hard to control;"

units.zh: 及知勸之後，在寬則典憲得宜。
units.en: "once people have been taught and encouraged, leniency allows the code and laws to be properly applied."
units.literal: "once people have been taught and encouraged, leniency allows the code and laws to be properly applied."

units.zh: 相時而行，庶臻中道。
units.en: "Act according to the times, so that the middle Way may be attained."
units.literal: "Act according to the times, so that the middle Way may be attained."

units.zh: 今後應犯竊盜賊贓及和奸者，並依晉天福元年已前條制施行。
units.en: "Henceforth those guilty of theft, robbery, plunder, or adultery shall all be handled according to the regulations in force before Later Jin Tianfu 1."
units.literal: "Henceforth those guilty of theft, robbery, plunder, and adultery shall all be handled according to the regulations in force before the first year of Later Jin's Tianfu era."

units.zh: 應諸犯罪人等，除反逆罪外，其罪並不得籍沒家產、誅及骨肉，一依格令處分。
units.en: "For all offenders, except in cases of treason, offenses shall not entail confiscation of household property or execution of kinsmen — all shall be handled according to the statutes and regulations."
units.literal: "As for all offenders, except for the crime of treason, their offenses shall not entail confiscation of household property or execution of kinsmen — all shall be handled according to the statutes and regulations."

units.zh: 天下諸侯，皆有親戚，自可慎擇委任，必當克效參裨。
units.en: "Regional lords throughout the realm all have kinsmen of their own. Let them choose and appoint carefully — such men can serve effectively as assistants."
units.literal: "Regional lords throughout the realm all have kinsmen; they may themselves carefully choose and appoint them, and they will surely be able to serve effectively as assistants."

units.zh: 朝廷選差，理或未當，宜矯前失，庶葉通規。
units.en: "Court appointments may not always have been appropriate. Past errors should be corrected so that common practice may be restored."
units.literal: "Court selection and assignment may in principle not have been appropriate; past errors ought to be corrected, so that common norms may be harmonized."

units.zh: 其先於在京諸司差軍將充諸州郡元從都押衙、孔目官、內知客等，並可停廢，仍勒卻還舊處職役。
units.en: "Army officers previously dispatched from capital bureaus to serve as chief yamen officers, clerks, and inner reception officers in the prefectures are abolished and ordered back to their former posts."
units.literal: "Those previously dispatched from capital bureaus as army officers to serve as original followers' chief yamen officers, clerks, and inner reception officers in various prefectures and counties — all may be abolished, and they are ordered to return to their former posts and duties."

units.zh: 近代帝王陵寢，合禁樵采。
units.en: "The tombs of recent emperors and kings shall be protected from woodcutting and gathering."
units.literal: "The tombs of emperors and kings in recent ages ought to be protected from woodcutting and gathering."

units.zh: 唐莊宗、明宗、晉高祖，各置守陵十戶，以近陵人戶充。
units.en: "For the tombs of Tang Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and Jin Gaozu, ten guard households each shall be established from nearby families."
units.literal: "Tang Zhuangzong, Mingzong, and Jin Gaozu — each shall have ten tomb-guard households established, filled from households near the tombs."

units.zh: 漢高祖皇帝陵署職員及守宮人，時日薦饗，並守陵人戶等，一切如故。
units.en: "The tomb staff, palace guards, seasonal offerings, and guard households at Han Gaozu's tomb shall all remain as before."
units.literal: "Staff of the tomb office of Han Gaozu and tomb-guard personnel, seasonal offerings, and tomb-guard households — all remain as before."

units.zh: 仍以晉、漢之胄為二王後，委中書門下處分雲。
units.en: "The scions of Jin and Han shall continue as the Two Noble Descendants; the Secretariat and Chancellery are charged to arrange the matter," the edict concluded.
units.literal: "The scions of Jin and Han are still to serve as the Two Noble Descendants; charge the Secretariat and Chancellery to arrange matters," it said.

units.zh: 司天上言：「今國家建號，以木德代水，準經法國以姓墓為臘，請以未日為臘。」
units.en: The Directorate of Astronomy submitted: "Now that the state has been founded, Wood replaces Water as the ruling element. By canonical law the La festival follows the tomb day of the dynastic surname — we request that the wei day be observed as La."
units.literal: The Directorate of Astronomy submitted a memorial saying: "Now that the state has established its title, Wood virtue replaces Water; according to canonical law the state takes the surname tomb day as the La festival — we request that the wei day be taken as La."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: The request was approved.

units.zh: 時議者曰：「昔武王勝殷，歲集於房，國家受命，金、木集於房。
units.en: Commentators of the time said: "When King Wu conquered Yin, the year star gathered in Fang; when the state received the Mandate, Metal and Wood gathered there as well.
units.literal: Commentators of the time said: "In antiquity when King Wu conquered Yin, the year star gathered in Fang; when the state received the Mandate, Metal and Wood gathered in Fang.

units.zh: 文王厄羑裏，而卦遇明夷，帝脫於鄴，大衍之數，復得明夷，則周為國號，符於文、武矣。」
units.en: King Wen suffered at Youli and drew the hexagram Mingyi; the Emperor escaped at Ye and the Great Evolution numbers again yielded Mingyi — thus the state title Zhou accorded with King Wen and King Wu."
units.literal: King Wen suffered hardship at Youli, and the hexagram encountered Mingyi; the Emperor escaped at Ye, and in the numbers of the Great Evolution Mingyi was obtained again — thus Zhou as the state title accorded with Wen and Wu."

units.zh: 先是，丁未年夏六月，土、金、木、火四星聚於張，占者雲，當有帝王興於周者。
units.en: Earlier, in the sixth month of summer in the dingwei year, the Earth, Metal, Wood, and Fire stars gathered in Zhang; diviners declared that an emperor would rise under the name Zhou.
units.literal: Earlier, in summer, the sixth month of the dingwei year, Earth, Metal, Wood, and Fire stars gathered in Zhang; diviners said that an emperor or king would rise in Zhou.

units.zh: 故漢祖建國，由平陽、陜服趨洛陽以應之，及隱帝將嗣位，封周王以符其事。
units.en: Therefore when Han's founder established the dynasty, he moved from Pingyang and Shanfu toward Luoyang to fulfill the omen; when Emperor Yin was about to succeed, he enfeoffed a Prince of Zhou to match it.
units.literal: Therefore when Han's ancestor established the state, he moved from Pingyang and Shanfu toward Luoyang to accord with it; when Emperor Yin was about to succeed the throne, he enfeoffed the Prince of Zhou to match the matter.

units.zh: 而帝以姬虢之胄，復繼宗周，而天下之契炳然矣。
units.en: Now the Emperor, as a scion of Ji and Guo, has restored the Zhou line — and Heaven's design for the realm stands plain.
units.literal: Yet the Emperor, as a scion of Ji and Guo, again succeeded the ancestral Zhou — and the accord of all under Heaven was luminous.

units.zh: 昔武王以木德王天下，宇文周亦承木德，而三朝皆以木代水，不其異乎！
units.en: King Wu once ruled the realm under Wood; the Yuwen Zhou also claimed Wood — yet three dynasties all replaced Water with Wood. What a remarkable pattern!
units.literal: In antiquity King Wu ruled all under Heaven with Wood virtue; the Yuwen Zhou also inherited Wood virtue — yet three dynasties all used Wood to replace Water; is this not strange!

units.zh: 戊辰，前曹州防禦使何福進受宣權許州節度使，前復州防禦使王彥超受宣權徐州節度使，前澶州節度使李洪義受宣權宋州節度使。
units.en: On wuchen, former Caozhou Defender He Fujin was proclaimed acting Military Governor of Xu Prefecture; former Fuzhou Defender Wang Yanchao was proclaimed acting Military Governor of Xuzhou; former Chanzhou Military Governor Li Hongyi was proclaimed acting Military Governor of Songzhou.
units.literal: On the day wuchen, the former Defender of Caozhou He Fujin received the proclamation and was appointed acting Military Governor of Xu Prefecture; the former Defender of Fuzhou Wang Yanchao received the proclamation and was appointed acting Military Governor of Xuzhou; the former Military Governor of Chanzhou Li Hongyi received the proclamation and was appointed acting Military Governor of Songzhou.

units.zh: 己巳，上漢太后尊號曰昭聖皇太后。
units.en: On jisi the Han Empress Dowager was given the honorific title Empress Dowager Zhaosheng.
units.literal: On the day jisi, the honorific title Zhaosheng Empress Dowager was bestowed upon the Han Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 是日，詔有司擇日為故主發哀。
units.en: That day an edict ordered the relevant offices to set a date for mourning the former sovereign.
units.literal: That day an edict ordered the relevant offices to choose a day to proclaim mourning for the former sovereign.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》載原敕云：漢高祖為義帝發喪，魏明帝正禪陵尊號，一時達禮，千古所稱，況朕久事前朝，常參大政，雖遷虞事夏，見奪於群情，而四海九州，咸知予夙志。
units.en: (The Institutional Compendium of the Five Dynasties records the original edict: Han Gaozu proclaimed mourning for Emperor Yi; Wei Mingdi corrected the honorific of the Zen tomb — both timely fulfillment of ritual, praised through the ages. I long served the previous dynasty and regularly participated in great affairs. Though yielding Yu to serve Xia, I was displaced by public sentiment, yet all the realm knows my longstanding intent.
units.literal: (The "Institutional Compendium of the Five Dynasties" records the original edict as saying: Han Gaozu proclaimed mourning for the Emperor Yi; Wei Mingdi corrected the honorific title of the Zen tomb — timely fulfillment of ritual, praised through the ages; moreover I long served the previous dynasty and regularly participated in great affairs; though yielding Yu to serve Xia, I was displaced by public sentiment, yet the four seas and nine provinces all know my longstanding intent.

units.zh: 宜令所司擇日為故主舉哀，仍備山陵葬禮。）〉
units.en: Let the relevant offices choose a day to proclaim mourning for the former sovereign and provide full mountain-tomb burial rites.) (End of editorial note.)〉
units.literal: The relevant offices should be ordered to choose a day to proclaim mourning for the former sovereign, and also to provide full mountain-tomb burial rites.) (End of editorial note.)〉

units.zh: 辛未，有司上言：「皇帝為故主舉哀日，服縞素，直領深衣、腰绖等。
units.en: On xinwei the relevant offices submitted: "On the day the Emperor proclaims mourning for the former sovereign, he shall wear unbleached hemp, a straight-collared deep robe, and a waist mourning sash.
units.literal: On the day xinwei, the relevant offices submitted a memorial saying: "On the day the Emperor proclaims mourning for the former sovereign, he shall wear unbleached hemp, a straight-collared deep robe, a waist mourning sash, and the like.

units.zh: 成服畢祭奠，不視朝七日，坊市禁音樂。
units.en: After the mourning garments are complete and offerings performed, he shall not hold court for seven days, and music shall be forbidden in the wards and markets.
units.literal: When the mourning garments are complete and the offerings performed, he shall not hold court for seven days, and music shall be forbidden in wards and markets.

units.zh: 文武內外臣僚成服後，每日赴太平宮臨，三日止，七日釋服。
units.en: After civil and military officials complete their mourning garments, they shall attend daily mourning rites at Taiping Palace for three days, then cease; on the seventh day they shall lay mourning aside.
units.literal: After civil and military officials within and without complete their mourning garments, they shall daily attend mourning rites at Taiping Palace for three days, then cease; on the seventh day they shall remove mourning dress.

units.zh: 至山陵啟攢塗日，服初服，盾車出城，班辭釋服。」
units.en: On the day the mountain tomb is opened and the coffin sealed, he shall wear initial mourning dress; the shield carriage departs the city, and after the farewell ceremony he shall lay mourning aside."
units.literal: On the day the mountain tomb is opened and the coffin sealed, he shall wear initial mourning dress; the shield carriage departs the city, and after the farewell ceremony mourning dress is removed."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The memorial was approved.
units.literal: The memorial was approved.

units.zh: 壬申，前博州刺史李筠受宣權滑州節度使。
units.en: On renshen, former Bozhou Prefect Li Yun was proclaimed acting Military Governor of Huazhou.
units.literal: On the day renshen, the former Prefect of Bozhou Li Yun received the proclamation and was appointed acting Military Governor of Huazhou.

units.zh: 癸酉，樞密使、檢校太傅王峻加同平章事；
units.en: On guiyou, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs Wang Jun, Grand Preceptor by special appointment, was made Grand Councilor;
units.literal: On the day guiyou, Wang Jun, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Grand Preceptor by special appointment, was made Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 以前澶州節度使李洪義為宋州節度使，加同平章事。
units.en: former Chanzhou Military Governor Li Hongyi was made Military Governor of Songzhou and appointed Grand Councilor.
units.literal: the former Military Governor of Chanzhou Li Hongyi was made Military Governor of Songzhou and appointed Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 以滑州節度副使陳觀為左散騎常侍，鄴都留守判官王溥為左諫議大夫，並充樞密院直學士。
units.en: Huazhou Deputy Military Governor Chen Guan was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, and Yedu Garrison Aide Wang Pu was made Left Remonstrance Grandee — both appointed Direct Academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: Chen Guan, deputy military governor of Huazhou, was made Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry; Wang Pu, administrative aide to the Yedu garrison commander, was made Left Remonstrance Grandee — both appointed Direct Academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 以元從都押衙鄭仁誨為客省使，知客押牙向訓為宮苑使。
units.en: Original-follower Chief Yamen Officer Zheng Renhui was made Commissioner of the Reception Bureau, and Reception Officer Xiang Xun was made Commissioner of the Palace Parks.
units.literal: Zheng Renhui, chief yamen officer of the original followers, was made Commissioner of the Reception Bureau; Xiang Xun, reception officer and yamen guard, was made Commissioner of the Palace Parks.

units.zh: 北京留守劉崇遣押牙鞏廷美致書，求劉赟歸藩。
units.en: Northern Capital Garrison Commander Liu Chong sent his yamen guard Gong Tingmei with a letter requesting Liu Yun's return to his post.
units.literal: Liu Chong, garrison commander of the Northern Capital, sent his yamen guard Gong Tingmei with a letter requesting that Liu Yun be returned to his frontier post.

units.zh: 帝報曰：「朕在澶州之時，軍情推戴之際，先差來直省李光美備見，必想具言，而況遐邇所聞，在後盡當知悉。
units.en: The Emperor replied: "When I was at Chanzhou and the army urged my elevation, I first dispatched Palace Attendant Li Guangmei, who witnessed everything — you must have heard the full account by now. What near and far have heard will all become clear in time.
units.literal: The Emperor replied: "When I was at Chanzhou, at the moment the army urged my elevation, I first dispatched the palace attendant Li Guangmei, who witnessed everything in full — you must surely have heard the full account; moreover what near and far have heard will all become known in time.

units.zh: 湘陰公比在宋州駐泊，見令般取赴京，但勿憂疑，必令得所。
units.en: The Lord of Xiangyin is presently at Songzhou and has been ordered brought to the capital. Do not worry — he will surely be properly provided for.
units.literal: The Lord of Xiangyin is presently stationed at Songzhou; he has now been ordered brought to the capital — but do not worry or doubt; he will surely be properly provided for.

units.zh: 惟公在彼，固請安心，若能同力扶持，別無顧慮，即當便封王爵，永鎮北門，鐵券丹書，必無愛惜。
units.en: As for you there, set your mind at ease. If you lend your strength in joint support without other concern, I shall at once enfeoff you as prince and charge you forever with guarding the northern gate — iron certificates and cinnabar writs will be granted without stint.
units.literal: As for you there, I earnestly ask you to set your mind at ease; if you can jointly lend your strength in support, with no other concern, I shall at once enfeoff you with princely rank, forever guarding the northern gate — iron certificates and cinnabar writs will surely be granted without stint.

units.zh: 其諸情素，並令來人口宣。」
units.en: All these matters shall also be conveyed orally by the envoy."
units.literal: As for all these circumstances, they shall also be orally proclaimed by the envoy who comes."

units.zh: 遣千牛衛將軍未憲充入契丹使。
units.en: He dispatched Qianniu Guard General Zhu Xian to serve as envoy to the Khitan.
units.literal: He dispatched Qianniu Guard General Zhu Xian to serve as envoy to the Khitan.

units.zh: 先是，去年契丹永康王烏裕寇邢、趙，陷內丘，及回，兀裕遣使與漢隱帝書，
units.en: Earlier, the year before, Khitan Prince Yongkang Wuyu had raided Xing and Zhao and captured Neiqiu. On his return Wuyu sent an envoy with a letter to the Hidden Emperor of Han,
units.literal: Previously, in the previous year the Khitan Prince of Yongkang Wuyu raided Xing and Zhao, captured Neiqiu, and upon his return Wuyu dispatched an envoy with a letter to the Hidden Emperor of Han,

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：契丹之攻內丘也，死傷頗多，又值月食，軍中多妖異，契丹主不敢深入，引兵還，遣使請和於漢。）〉
units.en: (The Comprehensive Mirror records that in the attack on Neiqiu Khitan casualties were heavy; a lunar eclipse followed, and strange omens multiplied in the camp. The Khitan ruler dared not advance further, withdrew his army, and sent an envoy to sue for peace with Han.) (End of editorial note.)〉
units.literal: (From the "Comprehensive Mirror": when the Khitan attacked Neiqiu, dead and wounded were many; moreover a lunar eclipse occurred and many strange omens appeared in the army. The Khitan ruler dared not press deep, withdrew his forces, and dispatched an envoy to sue for peace with Han.) (End of editorial note.)〉

units.zh: 使至境上，會朝廷有蕭墻之變，帝定京城，回至澶州，遇蕃使至，遂與入朝。
units.en: When the envoy reached the border, the court was convulsed by internal strife. After the Emperor secured the capital he returned to Chan Prefecture, met the arriving Khitan envoy, and entered court with him.
units.literal: When the envoy reached the frontier, the court was struck by internal turmoil; after the Emperor secured the capital he returned to Chan Prefecture, met the barbarian envoy arriving, and entered court together with him.

units.zh: 至是，遣朱憲伴送來使歸蕃，兼致書敘革命之由，仍以金酒器一副、玉帶一遺兀裕。
units.en: At this point he sent Zhu Xian to escort the Khitan envoy home, with a letter explaining the change of dynasty, and presented Wuyu with a set of gold wine vessels and a jade belt.
units.literal: At this time he dispatched Zhu Xian to escort the incoming envoy back to the barbarians, also sending a letter explaining the reason for the dynastic change, and presenting Wuyu with one set of gold wine vessels and one jade belt.

units.zh: 晉州節度使王晏殺行軍司馬徐建，以通河東聞。
units.en: Jin Prefecture Military Governor Wang Yan killed March Chief of Staff Xu Jian and notified Hedong.
units.literal: Jin Prefecture Military Governor Wang Yan killed March Chief of Staff Xu Jian and reported the act to Hedong.

units.zh: 乙亥，鄆州節度使、守太師、兼中書令、齊王高行周進位尚書令；
units.en: On yihai, Yan Prefecture Military Governor, Grand Preceptor, concurrent Grand Censor, and Prince of Qi Gao Xingzhou was promoted to Minister-in-Chief;
units.literal: On the day yihai, Yan Prefecture Military Governor, Grand Preceptor in attendance, concurrent Grand Censor, Prince of Qi Gao Xingzhou was advanced to Minister-in-Chief;

units.zh: 襄州節度使、檢校太師、守太傅、兼中書令、齊國公安審琦進封南陽王；
units.en: Xiang Prefecture Military Governor, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Grand Mentor, concurrent Grand Censor, and Duke of Qi An Shenqi was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang;
units.literal: Xiang Prefecture Military Governor, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Grand Mentor in attendance, concurrent Grand Censor, Duke of Qi An Shenqi was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang;

units.zh: 青州節度使、檢校太師、守太保、兼中書令、魏國公符彥卿進封淮陽王，夔州節度使、侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、檢校太傅王殷加同平章事，充鄴都留守，典軍如故。
units.en: Qing Prefecture Military Governor, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Grand Guardian, concurrent Grand Censor, and Duke of Wei Fu Yanqing was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang; Kuizhou Military Governor and Palace Guard Commander Wang Yin was made concurrent Grand Councilor and appointed Ye Capital Garrison Commander, retaining command of his troops.
units.literal: Qing Prefecture Military Governor, Honorary Grand Preceptor, Grand Guardian in attendance, concurrent Grand Censor, Duke of Wei Fu Yanqing was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang; Kuizhou Military Governor, Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Horse and Foot Armies, Honorary Grand Mentor Wang Yin was additionally appointed concurrent Grand Councilor, appointed Ye Capital Garrison Commander, command of troops as before.

units.zh: 丙子，帝赴太平宮，為漢隱帝發喪，百官陪位如儀。
units.en: On bingzi the Emperor went to Taiping Palace to proclaim mourning for the Hidden Emperor of Han, and the officials attended in ritual order.
units.literal: On the day bingzi, the Emperor went to Taiping Palace to proclaim mourning for the Hidden Emperor of Han; the hundred officials attended in their stations according to ritual.

units.zh: 是日，湘陰公元從右都押衙鞏廷美、教練使楊溫等，據徐州以拒命。
units.en: That day Lord of Xiangyin Liu Yun's chief yamen officer Gong Tingmei, drill instructor Yang Wen, and others seized Xuzhou in defiance of orders.
units.literal: That day, the Lord of Xiangyin Liu Yun's chief yamen officer Gong Tingmei, drill instructor Yang Wen, and others seized Xuzhou in defiance of orders.

units.zh: 帝遣新授節度使王彥超率兵馳赴之，仍賜廷美等敕書。
units.en: The Emperor sent the newly appointed Military Governor Wang Yanchao with troops in haste and granted edicts to Tingmei and his fellows.
units.literal: The Emperor dispatched the newly appointed military governor Wang Yanchao to rush troops there, and also granted edicts to Tingmei and the others.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：帝復遺劉赟書曰：「爰念斯人，盡心於主，足以賞其忠義，何由責以悔尤。
units.en: (The Comprehensive Mirror records that the Emperor again wrote Liu Yun: "Considering this man, he gave his all for his lord — loyalty enough to merit reward; how could one reproach him for regret?
units.literal: (From the "Comprehensive Mirror": the Emperor again sent Liu Yun a letter saying: "Reflecting on this man, he gave his utmost for his lord — enough to reward his loyalty and righteousness; how could one blame him for regret?

units.zh: 俟新節度入城，當各除刺史，公可更以委曲示之。」）〉
units.en: When the new military governor enters the city, each shall be appointed regional prefect. You may explain this fully to them.") (End of editorial note.)〉
units.literal: When the new military governor enters the city, each shall be appointed regional prefect; you, sir, may again explain this fully to them.") (End of editorial note.)〉

units.zh: 丁丑，荊南高保融奏：去年十一月，朗州節度使馬希萼破潭州；
units.en: On dingchou Jingnan's Gao Baorong memorialized that in the eleventh month of the previous year Lang Prefecture Military Governor Ma Xie had captured Tan Prefecture;
units.literal: On the day dingchou, Jingnan Gao Baorong memorialized: In the eleventh month of last year, Lang Prefecture Military Governor Ma Xie captured Tan Prefecture;

units.zh: 十二月十八日，縊殺馬希廣；
units.en: on the eighteenth of the twelfth month Ma Xiguang was strangled;
units.literal: On the eighteenth day of the twelfth month, Ma Xiguang was strangled to death;

units.zh: 至十九日，希萼自稱天策上將軍、武平靜江寧遠等軍節度使、嗣楚王。
units.en: and on the nineteenth Xie styled himself Generalissimo of Heavenly Strategy, Military Governor of Wuping, Jingjiang, Ningyuan and other armies, and successor King of Chu.
units.literal: On the nineteenth, Xie styled himself Generalissimo of Heavenly Strategy, Military Governor of Wuping, Jingjiang, Ningyuan and other armies, and successor King of Chu.

units.zh: 戊寅，湘陰公殂。
units.en: On wuyin the Lord of Xiangyin died.
units.literal: On the day wuyin, the Lord of Xiangyin died.

units.zh: 己卯，以前太師、齊國公馮道為中書令、宏文館大學士；
units.en: On jimao former Grand Preceptor and Duke of Qi Feng Dao was appointed Grand Censor and Grand Academician of the Hall for the Extension of Culture;
units.literal: On the day jimao, the former Grand Preceptor, Duke of Qi Feng Dao was appointed Grand Censor and Grand Academician of the Hall for the Extension of Culture;

units.zh: 以司徒兼門下侍郎、同平章事、宏文館大學士竇貞固為侍中，監修國史；
units.en: Minister of Education, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician Dou Zhengu was made Palace Secretary and put in charge of compiling the national history;
units.literal: Minister of Education, concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall for the Extension of Culture Dou Zhengu was appointed Palace Secretary and overseer of the compilation of the national history;

units.zh: 以左僕射、平章事、集賢殿大學士蘇禹珪為守司空、平章事；
units.en: Left Vice Director, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician Su Yugui was appointed Honorary Minister of Works and retained as Grand Councilor;
units.literal: Left Vice Director, Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies Su Yugui was appointed Honorary Minister of Works and Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 夏州節度使李彜興進封隴西郡王，荊南高保融進封渤海郡王，靈武馮暉進封陳留郡王；
units.en: Xia Prefecture Military Governor Li Yixing was enfeoffed as Prince of Longxi; Jingnan's Gao Baorong as Prince of Bohai; and Lingwu's Feng Hui as Prince of Chenliu;
units.literal: Xia Prefecture Military Governor Li Yixing was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Longxi Commandery; Jingnan Gao Baorong was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Bohai Commandery; Lingwu Feng Hui was advanced and enfeoffed as Prince of Chenliu Commandery;

units.zh: 西京白文珂、兗州慕容彥超、鳳翔趙暉並加兼中書令。
units.en: Bai Wenke of the Western Capital, Murong Yanchao of Yan Prefecture, and Zhao Hui of Fengxiang were all made concurrent Grand Censor.
units.literal: Western Capital Bai Wenke, Yan Prefecture Murong Yanchao, and Fengxiang Zhao Hui were all additionally appointed concurrent Grand Censor.

units.zh: 詔王彥超率兵攻徐州。
units.en: An edict ordered Wang Yanchao to lead troops against Xuzhou.
units.literal: An edict ordered Wang Yanchao to lead troops to attack Xuzhou.

units.zh: 庚辰，故樞密使、左僕射、平章事楊邠追封恒農郡王，故宋州節度使兼侍衛親軍都指揮使史宏肇追封鄭王，故三司使、檢校太尉、平章事王章追封郎琊郡王。
units.en: On gengchen the late Commissioner of Military Affairs Yang Bin was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Hengnong; the late Song Prefecture Military Governor and Palace Guard Commander Shi Hongzhao as Prince of Zheng; and the late Commissioner of the Three Departments Wang Zhang as Prince of Langya.
units.literal: On the day gengchen, the late Commissioner of Military Affairs, Left Vice Director, and Grand Councilor Yang Bin was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Hengnong Commandery; the late Song Prefecture Military Governor and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard Shi Hongzhao was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng; the late Commissioner of the Three Departments, Honorary Grand Commandant, and Grand Councilor Wang Zhang was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Langya Commandery.

units.zh: 是日，詔曰：
units.en: That day an edict proclaimed:
units.literal: That day, an edict stated:

units.zh: 朕以眇末之身，托於王公之上，懼德弗類，撫躬靡遑，豈可化未及人而過自奉養，道未方古而不知節量。
units.en: I, a slight and humble man set above kings and dukes, fear my virtue falls short and can scarce examine myself. How could I lavish self-indulgence before my transforming influence has reached the people, or fail to restrain my measure when my conduct has not yet matched antiquity?
units.literal: I, with my slight and humble person, am placed above kings and dukes; fearing my virtue does not measure up, I can scarce regard myself — how could I indulge in self-providing before my transforming influence has reached the people, or fail to restrain my measure when my Way has not yet equaled antiquity?

units.zh: 與其耗費以勞人，曷若儉約而克己。
units.en: Better thrift and self-restraint than wasteful spending that burdens the people.
units.literal: Rather than lavish expenditure that burdens the people, how much better to practice thrift and restrain oneself.

units.zh: 昨者所頒赦令，已述至懷。
units.en: The amnesty recently issued already expressed my inmost intent.
units.literal: In the amnesty recently promulgated, my inmost feelings were already set forth.

units.zh: 宮闈服禦之所須，悉從減損；
units.en: Palace needs for clothing and daily use shall all be cut back;
units.literal: All needs of the palace for clothing and daily use shall be reduced;

units.zh: 珍巧纖奇之厥貢，並使寢停。
units.en: exquisite and rare tribute items shall cease entirely.
units.literal: Exquisite, clever, fine and rare tribute items shall all be halted.

units.zh: 尚有未該，再宜條舉。
units.en: Where matters remain unaddressed, they should be set forth again in detail.
units.literal: Where matters remain unaddressed, they should again be listed in detail.

units.zh: 應天下州府舊貢滋味食饌之物，所宜除減。
units.en: Old tribute of savory foods and delicacies from prefectures throughout the realm should be abolished or reduced.
units.literal: The old tribute of savory foods and delicacies from prefectures throughout the realm should be abolished or reduced.

units.zh: 其兩浙進細酒、海味、姜瓜，湖南枕子茶、乳糖、白沙糖、橄欖子，鎮州高公米、水梨，易、定粟子，河東白社梨、米粉、綠豆粉、玉屑鞏子面，永興禦田紅粳米、新大麥面，興平蘇粟子，華州麝香、羚羊角、熊膽、獺肝、朱柿、熊白，河中樹紅棗、五味子、輕餳，同州石𨫼餅，晉、絳葡萄、黃消梨，陜府鳳棲梨，襄州紫姜、新筍、橘子，安州折粳米、糟味，青州水梨，河陽諸雜果子，許州禦李子，鄭州新筍、鵝梨，懷州寒食杏仁，申州蘘荷，亳州萆薢，沿淮州郡淮白魚，如聞此等之物，雖皆出於土產，亦有取於民家，未免勞煩，率皆糜費。
units.en: Fine wine, seafood, ginger, and melons from the Two Zhes; pillow tea, milk sugar, white sand sugar, and olives from Hunan; Gao-family rice and water pears from Zhen Prefecture; chestnuts from Yi and Ding; white she pears, rice flour, mung bean flour, and jade-dust gongzi noodles from Hedong; imperial-field red japonica rice and new barley flour from Yongxing; su millet from Xingping; musk, antelope horn, bear gall, otter liver, red persimmons, and bear fat from Hua Prefecture; tree red dates, schisandra, and light malt sugar from Hezhong; stone jiang cakes from Tong Prefecture; grapes and yellow xiao pears from Jin and Jiang; phoenix-perch pears from Shaan Prefecture; purple ginger, fresh bamboo shoots, and oranges from Xiang Prefecture; broken japonica rice and fermented delicacies from An Prefecture; water pears from Qing Prefecture; assorted fruits from Heyang; imperial Li plums from Xu Prefecture; fresh bamboo shoots and goose pears from Zheng Prefecture; Cold Food Festival almonds from Huai Prefecture; lotus root from Shen Prefecture; bi xie from Bo Prefecture; Huai white fish from prefectures along the Huai — I am told that although these are local products, many are exacted from common households, causing needless hardship and mostly going to waste.
units.literal: From the Two Zhes come fine wine, seafood, ginger and melons; from Hunan pillow tea, milk sugar, white sand sugar, and olives; from Zhen Prefecture Gao-family rice and water pears; from Yi and Ding chestnuts; from Hedong white she pears, rice flour, mung bean flour, and jade-dust gongzi noodles; from Yongxing imperial-field red japonica rice and new barley flour; from Xingping su millet seeds; from Hua Prefecture musk, antelope horn, bear gall, otter liver, red persimmons, and bear fat; from Hezhong tree red dates, schisandra, and light malt sugar; from Tong Prefecture stone jiang cakes; from Jin and Jiang grapes and yellow xiao pears; from Shaan Prefecture phoenix-perch pears; from Xiang Prefecture purple ginger, fresh bamboo shoots, and oranges; from An Prefecture broken japonica rice and fermented flavors; from Qing Prefecture water pears; from Heyang assorted fruits; from Xu Prefecture imperial Li plums; from Zheng Prefecture fresh bamboo shoots and goose pears; from Huai Prefecture Cold Food Festival almonds; from Shen Prefecture lotus root; from Bo Prefecture bi xie; from Huai River prefectures Huai white fish — I hear that although such things all come from local produce, some are taken from common households, unavoidably causing trouble; mostly they are wasted.

units.zh: 加之力役負荷，馳驅道途，積於有司之中，甚為無用之物，今後並不須進奉。
units.en: Add the labor of porters hauling loads along the roads, and the goods pile up in government stores as utterly useless things. Hereafter none of these need be sent as tribute.
units.literal: Added to this is the labor of porters bearing loads and rushing along the roads; piled up in government stores, these are utterly useless things — hereafter none need be sent as tribute.

units.zh: 諸州府更有舊例所進食味，其未該者，宜奏取進止。
units.en: For other food tributes under old precedent not covered here, prefectures should submit memorials for instructions.
units.literal: For other food tributes from prefectures under old precedent not covered here, memorials should be submitted for decision.

units.zh: 又詔在朝文武臣僚，各上封事，凡有益國利民之事，速具以聞。
units.en: Another edict ordered civil and military officials at court each to submit sealed memorials on any matter benefiting state or people, reporting at once.
units.literal: Another edict ordered civil and military officials at court each to submit sealed memorials; whatever benefits the state and benefits the people, report quickly.

units.zh: 〈（《通鑒》：詔曰：朕生長軍旅，不親學問，未知治天下之道。
units.en: (The Comprehensive Mirror records the edict: I was reared in the army and never pursued learning myself; I do not know how to govern the realm.
units.literal: (From the "Comprehensive Mirror": the edict stated: I was reared in the army and did not personally pursue learning; I do not know the Way of governing all under heaven.

units.zh: 文武官有益國利民之術，各具封事以聞，咸宜直書其事，勿事辭藻。）〉
units.en: Any civil or military official with policies that benefit state or people should submit sealed memorials; write plainly of the matter and do not trouble over literary ornament.) (End of editorial note.)〉
units.literal: Civil and military officials who have policies benefiting the state and the people should each submit sealed memorials; all should write plainly of the matter — do not trouble over literary ornament.) (End of editorial note.)〉

units.zh: 辛巳，鎮州武行德、晉州王晏、相州張彥成、潞州常思、邠州候章並加兼侍中；
units.en: On xinsi Wu Xingde of Zhen Prefecture, Wang Yan of Jin Prefecture, Zhang Yancheng of Xiang Prefecture, Chang Si of Lu Prefecture, and Hou Zhang of Bin Prefecture were all made concurrent Palace Secretary;
units.literal: On the day xinsi, Zhen Prefecture Wu Xingde, Jin Prefecture Wang Yan, Xiang Prefecture Zhang Yancheng, Lu Prefecture Chang Si, and Bin Prefecture Hou Zhang were all additionally appointed concurrent Palace Secretary;

units.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、果州防禦使、檢校太保郭崇為洋州節度使、檢校太傅，典軍如故；
units.en: Palace Guard Cavalry Commander and Defender of Guo Prefecture Guo Chong was appointed Military Governor of Yang Prefecture and Honorary Grand Mentor, retaining command of his troops;
units.literal: Palace Guard Cavalry Commander, Defender of Guo Prefecture, and Honorary Grand Guardian Guo Chong was appointed Military Governor of Yang Prefecture and Honorary Grand Mentor, command of troops as before;

units.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、岳州防禦使曹英為利州節度使、檢校太傅，典軍如故。
units.en: Palace Guard Infantry Commander and Defender of Yue Prefecture Cao Ying was appointed Military Governor of Li Prefecture and Honorary Grand Mentor, retaining command of his troops.
units.literal: Palace Guard Infantry Commander and Defender of Yue Prefecture Cao Ying was appointed Military Governor of Li Prefecture and Honorary Grand Mentor, command of troops as before.

units.zh: 癸未，涇州史懿、延州高允權、滄州王景、永興郭從義、定州孫方簡並加兼侍中，鄜州楊信、同州薛懷讓、貝州王繼宏並加同平章事。
units.en: On guiwei Shi Yi of Jing Prefecture, Gao Yunquan of Yan Prefecture, Wang Jing of Cang Prefecture, Guo Congyi of Yongxing, and Sun Fangjian of Ding Prefecture were made concurrent Palace Secretary; Yang Xin of Fu Prefecture, Xue Huairang of Tong Prefecture, and Wang Jihong of Bei Prefecture were made concurrent Grand Councilor.
units.literal: On the day guiwei, Jing Prefecture Shi Yi, Yan Prefecture Gao Yunquan, Cang Prefecture Wang Jing, Yongxing Guo Congyi, and Ding Prefecture Sun Fangjian were all additionally appointed concurrent Palace Secretary; Fu Prefecture Yang Xin, Tong Prefecture Xue Huairang, and Bei Prefecture Wang Jihong were all additionally appointed concurrent Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 乙酉，華州王饒、河中扈彥珂、鄧州折從阮、邢州劉詞並加同平章事。
units.en: On yiyou Wang Rao of Hua Prefecture, Hu Yanke of Hezhong, Zhe Congruan of Deng Prefecture, and Liu Ci of Xing Prefecture were made concurrent Grand Councilor.
units.literal: On the day yiyou, Hua Prefecture Wang Rao, Hezhong Hu Yanke, Deng Prefecture Zhe Congruan, and Xing Prefecture Liu Ci were all additionally appointed concurrent Grand Councilor.

units.zh: 丙戌，幸西莊。
units.en: On bingxu the Emperor visited the Western Villa.
units.literal: On the day bingxu, the Emperor visited the Western Villa.

units.zh: 潞州奏，得石會關使王延美報，河東劉崇於正月十六日僭號。
units.en: Lu Prefecture reported that Shihui Pass Commissioner Wang Yanmei had notified them that Liu Chong of Hedong had usurped the imperial title on the sixteenth of the first month.
units.literal: Lu Prefecture memorialized that it had received a report from Shihui Pass Commissioner Wang Yanmei that Hedong Liu Chong on the sixteenth day of the first month usurped the imperial title.

units.zh: 丁亥，以前澶州節度使李洪義為宋州節度使，加同平章事；
units.en: On dinghai former Chan Prefecture Military Governor Li Hongyi was appointed Military Governor of Song Prefecture and made concurrent Grand Councilor;
units.literal: On the day dinghai, the former Military Governor of Chan Prefecture Li Hongyi was appointed Military Governor of Song Prefecture and additionally appointed concurrent Grand Councilor;

units.zh: 以曹州防禦使、北面行營馬步都排陣使何福進為許州節度使，加檢校太傅；
units.en: Defender of Cao Prefecture and Northern Expeditionary Chief Array Marshal He Fujin was appointed Military Governor of Xu Prefecture and Honorary Grand Mentor;
units.literal: Defender of Cao Prefecture and Chief Array Marshal of the Northern Expeditionary Camp for Horse and Foot He Fujin was appointed Military Governor of Xu Prefecture and Honorary Grand Mentor;

units.zh: 以博州刺史、北面行營右廂排陣使李筠為滑州節度使，加檢校太保。
units.en: Prefect of Bo Prefecture and Northern Expeditionary Right Wing Array Marshal Li Jun was appointed Military Governor of Hua Prefecture and Honorary Grand Guardian.
units.literal: Prefect of Bo Prefecture and Right Wing Array Marshal of the Northern Expeditionary Camp Li Jun was appointed Military Governor of Hua Prefecture and Honorary Grand Guardian.

units.zh: 戊子，有司上言：「準赦書，以晉、漢之胄為二王後，其唐五廟仲祀合廢。」
units.en: On wuzi the relevant offices submitted: "Under the amnesty, descendants of Jin and Han are appointed heirs of the two dynasties; the mid-year sacrifice at the Five Temples of Tang should be abolished."
units.literal: On the day wuzi, the relevant offices submitted a memorial saying: "According to the amnesty, descendants of Jin and Han are to serve as heirs of the two dynasties; the mid-year sacrifice at the Five Temples of Tang should jointly be abolished."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was approved.
units.literal: It was ordered.

units.zh: 庚寅，宗正寺奏：「請以晉、漢故事，遷漢七廟神主入升平宮，行仲享之禮，以漢宗子為三獻。」
units.en: On gengyin the Office of the Imperial Clan submitted: "Following Jin and Han precedent, we request that the spirit tablets of Han's seven temples be moved to Shengping Palace for the mid-year offering, with a Han imperial clansman serving as thrice-presenter."
units.literal: On the day gengyin, the Office of the Imperial Clan submitted a memorial saying: "Following the precedents of Jin and Han, we request that the spirit tablets of the seven temples of Han be moved into Shengping Palace to perform the mid-year offering, with a Han imperial clansman serving as thrice-presenter."

units.zh: 從之。
